info.title: google_drive (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Google Drive API v3. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {access_token}. Files and folders are both represented as File resources. Use mimeType 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' to create a folder. The q parameter supports the Drive query language for filtering results.

get.summary: Enumerate files in Google Drive. Filter results with the q parameter using Drive query language (e.g., "name contains 'r
get.description: Enumerate files in Google Drive. Filter results with the q parameter using Drive query language (e.g., "name contains 'report'" or "'folderId' in parents").

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter expression using the Drive query language. Examples: "name contains 'budget'", "'folderID' in parents", "mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'".

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Upper bound on the number of files returned per page (default 10, max 1000).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of fields to include in the response.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Specifies sort order. Common values: name, modifiedTime, createdTime. Append ' desc' for descending order.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

200.description: {kind: 'drive#fileList', files: [{id, name, mimeType, parents, webViewLink}], nextPageToken, incompleteSearch}

post.summary: Generate a new file or folder. Set mimeType to 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' to create a folder.
post.description: Generate a new file or folder. Set mimeType to 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' to create a folder.

requestBody.description: Body: {name (required, string â€” name of the new file or folder), mimeType (optional, string â€” MIME type; use 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' to create a folder), parents (optional, array of strings â€” parent folder IDs)}

get.summary: Fetch metadata for a specific file or folder using its ID.
get.description: Fetch metadata for a specific file or folder using its ID.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Identifier of the file to fetch.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of fields to include in the response.

200.description: {kind: 'drive#file', id, name, mimeType, parents, webViewLink, alternateLink}

patch.summary: Modify file metadata. Use addParents/removeParents to relocate a file between folders. Use name to give a file a new nam
patch.description: Modify file metadata. Use addParents/removeParents to relocate a file between folders. Use name to give a file a new name.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Identifier of the file to modify.

parameters.name: addParents
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of parent folder IDs to add.

parameters.name: removeParents
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of parent folder IDs to remove.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of fields to include in the response.

requestBody.description: Body: {name (optional, string â€” new name for the file)}

delete.summary: Irreversibly remove a file. The file is destroyed immediately with no recovery option.
delete.description: Irreversibly remove a file. The file is destroyed immediately with no recovery option.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Identifier of the file to remove.

post.summary: Duplicate a file and return metadata for the newly created copy.
post.description: Duplicate a file and return metadata for the newly created copy.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Identifier of the file to duplicate.

requestBody.description: Body: {name (optional, string â€” name for the copy), parents (optional, array of strings â€” destination folder IDs)}

File.description: A file or folder resource stored in Google Drive.

mimeType.description: MIME type identifying the file format. Use 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' for folders.

parents.description: IDs of the folders containing this file.

webViewLink.description: URL to open this file in a Google editor or viewer in the browser.

alternateLink.description: Secondary link to access the file.
